title: "Don't alarm during phone calls" not working
body: Despite having the "Don't alarm during phone calls" option checked off, my alarms always fire when on a phone call. This usually makes me have to hang up because I can't dismiss the alert since my screen constantly turns off when I take the phone away from my ear.

comments.body:
@trpnblies7 Would you please close this issue if it has already been resolved?
If not, would you please include details about your phone and xDrip version and settings?
